title: Approximation of an isomorphism of completed local rings by pointed etale neighborhoods
statement: Let $S$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth], let $X,Y$ be schemes locally of finite type over $S$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $x\in X$, $y\in Y$ lie over $s\in S$. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Given an $\mathcal O_{S,s}$-algebra isomorphism $\varphi:\widehat{\mathcal O}_{Y,y}\xrightarrow{\sim}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{X,x}$ of completed local rings [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], for every integer $N\geq2$ there are morphisms $(X,x)\leftarrow(U,u)\to(Y,y)$ of pointed schemes over $S$ such that both arrows are etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and induce isomorphisms $\kappa(x)\to\kappa(u)$ and $\kappa(y)\to\kappa(u)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. These are the elementary etale neighbourhood conditions. Moreover, the two maps from $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{Y,y}$ to $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{U,u}$, one induced by $U\to Y$ and the other obtained by following $\varphi$ with the map induced by $U\to X$, agree modulo $\mathfrak m_u^N\widehat{\mathcal O}_{U,u}$, where $\mathfrak m_u$ is the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{U,u}$.

proof.text: Fix $N\geq2$. Compose the canonical completion map $\iota_Y:\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\widehat{\mathcal O}_{Y,y}$ with $\varphi$, obtaining the local $\mathcal O_{S,s}$-map $\theta:\mathcal O_{Y,y}\to\widehat{\mathcal O}_{X,x}$. Apply [lem-trf-local-map-completion-approximation] to this map with the given $N$. This gives $p:(U,u)\to(X,x)$ etale with unchanged residue field, and an $S$-map $f:(U,u)\to(Y,y)$ with the required congruence on $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$. The hypotheses are exactly the given locally Noetherian base, the two locally finite type structural maps, and the G-ring $\mathcal O_{S,s}$.

source.place: Tag 0CAV, first sentence, applying Tag 0CAU to the restriction of the given isomorphism

proof.text: For the maps $p,f$ just obtained, set $A=\mathcal O_{Y,y}$, $B=\mathcal O_{X,x}$, $C=\mathcal O_{U,u}$ and $D=\widehat C$. Apply [lem-trf-etale-completion-congruence] with the original $\varphi$ and $N$: Step 1 supplies its congruence hypothesis on $A$, since $g\circ\iota_A=\iota_C\circ f_u^{\sharp}$ by the definition of the completed stalk map; $p$ is etale with unchanged residue field. It gives that $Y$ is locally Noetherian, $A,B,C$ are Noetherian, $D$ is local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak n=\mathfrak m_CD$, and $\alpha=\widehat p^{\sharp}\circ\varphi:\widehat A\xrightarrow{\sim}D$ is an isomorphism. For the actual completed map $g=\widehat f^{\sharp}$, using $(\mathfrak m_CD)^N=\mathfrak m_C^ND$, it gives $g(z)-\alpha(z)\in\mathfrak n^N$ for every $z\in\widehat A$.

source.place: Tag 0CAV, lemma-isomorphism-approximation, proof: comparison of the X and U completions by lemma-flat-unramified, and the congruence diagram before passage to associated graded rings; the congruence is extended from the original local ring.

proof.text: Put $h=g\circ\alpha^{-1}:D\to D$. Step 2 and $N\geq2$ give $h(d)-d\in\mathfrak n^N\subseteq\mathfrak n^2$ for every $d\in D$. For $d\in\mathfrak n$ this implies $h(d)\in\mathfrak n$, since $\mathfrak n^2\subseteq\mathfrak n$. Apply [lem-trf-completion-near-identity-automorphism] to the Noetherian local ring $C$. It makes $h$ an automorphism, via its compatible inverses on all infinitesimal quotients; hence $g=h\circ\alpha$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0CAV, lemma-isomorphism-approximation, proof: generation in degree 1, induction with successive infinitesimal-quotient exact sequences, and passage to the completed rings; after identifying the given isomorphism with the identity.

proof.text: The map $f:U\to Y$ is locally of finite type: the composite $U\to X\to S$ is locally of finite type, and cancellation gives the assertion, both by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence](e),(f). The target $Y$ is locally Noetherian by Step 2. Its actual completed stalk map is the isomorphism $g$ of Step 3, so [lem-trf-completed-stalk-isomorphism-etale] gives an open neighbourhood $W\ni u$ on which $f$ is etale, and an isomorphism $\kappa(y)\to\kappa(u)$. Replace $U$ by $W$. The map to $X$ remains etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation], since the open immersion $W\hookrightarrow U$ is etale. Its residue field map is still that of Step 1. The local ring at $u$, its maximal ideal, and both completed maps are unchanged by restriction, so the congruence modulo $\mathfrak m_u^N\widehat{\mathcal O}_{U,u}$ from Step 2 holds with exactly the original $\varphi$. This supplies both elementary etale neighbourhoods and the requested approximation.
